lines.text: and mercy. In our day, the attitude of natural man who
resists dependence on the grace of God often finds expression
in the saying that man has a right to live. Well, has he not
such a right? After all he is not responsible for having
entered the stream of life in this world, and he therefore
seems to be under no obligation of gratitude to anyone for
the fact of his existence, and to bear no responsibility for
what he proposes to do with his life. Yet he has claims on
life, he voices demands. And this is the fundamental sin of
mankind-the failure to recognize that man is a creature,
man's assertion of his right to live.
As a creature he should be grateful for his life to his
Creator. But how can he be, when his life is one long
wearisome struggle with adverse fate? How can he give
thanks when his life has become a burden to him, an un-
endurable torment? When he sees no meaning or sense in his
life, and the meaning which he himself would like to confer
on his life is destroyed by a rutliless fate? Is it not under-
standable that there have been men who have cursed the
day of their birth? That there have been men who have
extolled as the supreme bliss never to have been born, and
as the second highest bliss to die young? Certainly it is
understandable that a man should love life because he feels
in himself the energy and the joy to accomplish work and
taste of pleasure, or when his life, however steep the path-
way, is leading to success and fulfilment. But what of the
man whose powers are impaired or destroyed, who because
of illness or poverty must forbid himself every enjoyment?
How can a man be grateful for the gift of life when his whole
being "is stretched upon the rack" and bent to work which
is weakening to the body and paralysing to the mind?
He will never be able to do so as long as he does not give
up the belief that he has any right to life, as long as he does
not realize himself to be a creature, as long as he supposes
that he must himself give meaning to his life. Do you seek
after God? Then you must know what the object of your
search is. What is the meaning of this word "God"? To be
